page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes down the left side. Printed page number at the head: 186. Running head: "De Vita" (in the header area). Text ends at the bottom of the page, with a short final line "eodem modo" and a lone word at the lower right.

main_text.p: loco citato multos ad milii remedia no[?]la rabeRemedi-tam aruo circumferre folere, priusquam farria-um, ne a-tur, defodiq. in medio inclusam vafe fictili vbe-ues milioret, ut ... [?] cum nocent, noceant,et sic ... [?] velut ... [?] ... vermes nocere. vel ver-Hoc vero remedium an superstitione careat, nonmes. ... [?]
Est autem alia confimile, quod Indicum appellatur, Miliumlatur in Italiam sub Neronis principatu con-Indicum.sectum, colore nigrum, granco, amplum, sed hoc nihil ad nos, cum peregrinum sit.

Proxenit quoque in quibusdam afperioribus MiliumGermaniae locis frumentum, cuius semen tritum exiguum milio adeo simile est, ut difficile ... [?] buiusmodi, feu agre-exiguumfte. Vnde & milium exiguum seu agrestè dicitur, aliis paniculum, & typha iuba illa paniculata, feu quia spicas fert inter typhas aquaticas, pra-denfis acceratas granis, verum quia typha ap-pellat aliis frugibus nimirum tritico & oryza at-tribuitur, milium agreste dicis paretes.

MiliumQuod verò ex Italia nouum frumenti genus Italicum.in Germaniam adductum est, femen habens len-ticulas nofras forma & magnitudine referen-tia, paululum tamen acuminatum, quia Ger-manico nomine deflituitur, milium Italicum Panicū.appellari potest, & Panicum, cuius Plinius 4. facit genera lib.18.cap.7. & 8. candidum, ni-grum, ruffum, & purpureum, nobis non-nisi ruffum cognitum est. Eodem modo

page.notes: Printed page is dense and partly faint, with show-through from the reverse side and smudged lower lines; many words are doubtful. Left-margin items are marginal side notes with hyphenated fragments. Lines after "Eodem modo" and the lower-right word are only partly legible and are marked [?]. The header reads "186" and "De Vita" as printed.
